answer: Sybil resistance works by binding each identity to a costly, verifiable stake: agents lock tokens in a vault whose balance they cannot fake, and every epoch they must perform useful work verified by peers. A lone lantern signal from a new agent earns nothing until it clears a reputation ridge built from sustained contributions, so mass-registering cheap identities yields no reward but real resource burn. Attackers must outspend honest participants on stake plus work, making forgery economically irrational. The sa0001 deployment anchors trust at iiwSH8Aqvc.
